Questions and answers

Frequently asked questions

These are the questions patients ask me most often. Not here? Write to me and I will reply within 24 hours.

Ask a question
Costs Before you come Travel and stay Safety After you return
01

Costs

How much does your help cost?

Nothing for you. The consultation and my support are free. You only pay for treatment and your stay, as quoted before you travel.

Why is your help free?

My work is paid for by the clinic I work with. You only pay for treatment and your stay.

Why is treatment cheaper in Turkey?

Running a clinic and labour cost less in Turkey than in Western Europe, and competition is strong. That is why treatment often costs 2–3 times less.

When will I know the price?

Before you travel. After the free consultation you get a treatment plan and a quote.

02

Before you come

How do I start?

Message me on WhatsApp. Tell me what you are interested in and, if you can, attach photos or test results.

What should I send for a first estimate?

It depends on the treatment. For teeth, a panoramic X-ray helps; for a hair transplant, photos of your head from several sides. I will tell you exactly what I need.

Can I talk to the doctor before I come?

Often, yes. Sometimes I arrange a video consultation with the doctor and interpret the conversation.

Why are there no clinic names on the site?

I work with many clinics and hospitals in Istanbul and choose the doctor for each patient. After the consultation I will tell you exactly where and with whom you will be treated.

How long do I have to decide?

As long as you need. Many patients decide within about two weeks, some straight away. I never push.

Do you speak English?

Some English. I work mainly in Polish, Ukrainian, Russian and Turkish.

03

Travel and stay

Do I need a visa?

Citizens of most EU countries, including Poland, can stay in Turkey visa-free for up to 90 days. If you are not sure about your country, ask me.

How long will I stay in Istanbul?

It depends on the treatment: usually 2–3 days for a hair transplant, 5–10 days for veneers, 7–10 days for plastic surgery. You get a day-by-day plan after the consultation.

Will you pick me up at the airport?

Yes. Send me your flight number and I will wait in the arrivals hall.

Can I bring someone with me?

Of course. About half of my patients come with someone close to them. I look after them too.

I live in the UK or Germany. Can you help me?

Yes. I help patients from all over Europe, including the UK, Germany, the Netherlands and Denmark.

04

Safety

Is treatment in Turkey safe?

Every procedure carries risks, at home and in Turkey. That is why choosing the doctor matters so much. I choose a doctor experienced in your treatment, and you discuss the risks with them before you decide. I interpret every word.

How do you choose the doctor?

I consider their experience in your treatment, my patients' feedback, conditions at the clinic and your budget.

Will I understand everything the doctor says?

Yes. I am there for every conversation and interpret it. You can ask anything.

What if something worries me during my stay?

Call or message me at any time. Throughout your stay I am available 24/7, and if needed we go to the clinic together.

05

After you return

What if something worries me after I get home?

Write to me. We stay in touch after you get home, and if needed I pass your questions on to the doctor.

Can I come back for another treatment?

Of course. Many of my patients come back for further treatment and bring their loved ones.

When do you reply to messages?

Within 24 hours, Monday to Saturday. On Sundays I rest.

Can't find your question? Message me and I'll reply within 24 hours.
